name: Bukidnon (Philippines)
description: A horizontal tricolour of white, red and black charged in the centre with a golden emblem: a downward-pointing spear behind a shield bearing the stylised profile of the Kitanglad mountain range.
history: The official dimensions are 34 by 64 inches, giving the unusual 17:32 proportion.

features.role: spear pointing downward toward the fly
shield bearing the profile of the Kitanglad mountain range
